title: Microsoft 365 Cuts Family OneDrive Storage from 6 TB to 2 TB
summary:
Microsoft has updated its Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscriptions to reduce the overall storage pool. Previously, these subscription tiers allowed one buyer to share a subscription with five additional family members, totaling six people using the service. Each person received 1 TB of OneDrive storage to use as they wished, resulting in a total of 6 TB of storage from a single subscription. However, Microsoft is now reducing this capacity to a total of 2 TB of OneDrive storage, shared among the six individuals.

Microsoft notes that the shared storage capacity now applies to the entire subscription rather than being assigned individually. This means your storage capacity isn't fixed and could affect others if you decide to store large files. It's important to note that all personal files, photos, and documents remain private by default, even with the shared storage system. However, your guaranteed capacity will depend on other members, as you all share the same storage pool. If you purchase additional storage capacity with OneDrive, it will be added to the shared pool that everyone can access. title: AnyPS5 Achieves Full PS5 GPU Shader Instruction Translation
summary:
A few weeks ago, we reported on an intriguing project called AnyPS5, which aims to bypass emulation entirely and run PlayStation 5 games natively on Windows and Linux. Today, the project reached a significant milestone by successfully translating 100% of the PlayStation 5 GPU shader instructions. This achievement means that the "Oberon" graphics processing engine within the PS5 has been fully decoded. All 1166 GPU shader instructions, based on the RDNA 2 GPU IP, are now covered under the AnyPS5 project. The project relinks PS5 executables into the host system's native format and reimplements the console's system libraries for dynamic linking, similar to Wine or Proton. Since the PS5 already runs on x86-64 Zen 2 hardware, which is similar to a modern PC, AnyPS5 skips CPU emulation and recompiles shaders into SPIR-V for Vulkan instead.

What is particularly interesting is that once GPU shader instructions are translated, all the system needs are PS5 libraries so they can be dynamically linked from a native PC port. This means the PS5 game will see the exact same system calls on a PC as it does on the console. However, the system libraries have not yet been fully translated, with current statistics showing 84.81% of system libraries translated. There are exactly 3034 system libraries native to the PS5, and currently, 2573 have been translated. Once the remaining 461 libraries are translated, we can expect PS5 games to run natively on PCs, bypassing emulation layers entirely.  Read full story

title: PC Shipments Drop 20.1% in Q3 2026, HP and Dell Hit Hardest
summary:
Worldwide PC shipments fell a steep 20.1% year over year in Q3 2026 to 62.7 million units, according to preliminary data from IDC, down from 78.5 million in the same quarter last year. It is the second straight quarterly decline, and a much deeper one than Q2, which IDC now lists as a 3.8% drop. Shipments also slipped 9.1% compared to Q2, even though Q3 is normally the bigger quarter. IDC puts this down to the first half of the year, when vendors and channels stocked up ahead of memory-driven price hikes. That pulled volume out of the second half, and with supply still constrained and prices high, Q3 apparently had little demand left to work with.

The three largest vendors took the hardest hits. HP shipments dropped 30.9% to 10.3 million units, Dell fell 25% to 7.6 million, and Lenovo, still first with a 23.8% share, was down 22.6% to 14.9 million. Together they gave up 4.2 points of market share. Apple and ASUS also shipped fewer PCs, down 11.3% and 8.6%. However, both fell slower than the market and ended up with a larger share, at 9.5% and 8.7%.  Read full story

title: Microsoft Promises Day-One Gaming on RTX Spark, but Call of Duty Has to Wait

Windows and Devices head Pavan Davuluri made the claim at Microsoft's Windows and Surface event on October 7, where he also said Call of Duty support is coming in 2027. That is an awkward gap, since Activision is a Microsoft-owned studio and the RTX Spark-equipped Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2,599 with shipping set for October 16.

Anti-cheat is probably the holdup, although Microsoft hasn't confirmed that. RTX Spark uses an Arm-based CPU, so games run on Windows on Arm, and kernel-level anti-cheat drivers have to be rebuilt for it. Call of Duty relies on Activision's own Ricochet anti-cheat, which, as far as we know, only works on x86 systems today. Davuluri did show Gears of War: E-Day running at 60 FPS on the Surface Laptop Ultra. However, the resolution and upscaling settings were not disclosed, so the figure says little about real performance. It also isn't clear how many of those "hundreds" of games are native Arm builds and how many run through emulation. NVIDIA released its RTX Spark toolkit for Windows-on-Arm game development in July, and EA, Embark, and Ubisoft committed titles such as Apex Legends, ARC Raiders, and Anno 117: Pax Romana at Gamescom.

title: AMD Engineer Details Zen 6 IBS Memory Profiler
summary:
AMD has detailed the IBS Memory Profiler, a little-discussed hardware feature in its upcoming Zen 6 processors. AMD engineer Bharata Bhasker Rao presented it at the Linux Plumbers Conference (LPC) 2026 in Prague on October 5. Instruction-Based Sampling (IBS) is AMD's existing profiling hardware, and Zen 6 adds a separate, lighter instance that only samples data memory accesses. Each sample hands the kernel the physical address of the access and shows whether the data came from DRAM or external memory such as CXL. That matters on tiered-memory servers, where Linux has to find frequently used ("hot") pages on slower CXL memory and move them to DRAM. AMD's EPYC 9006 "Venice" chips support memory expansion via CXL 3.1.

Linux currently finds those pages by scanning page tables and trapping page faults. AMD wants to feed the profiler's samples into pghot, a proposed kernel subsystem for hot page tracking. The results, however, are a mixed bag. On a test system with 256 logical CPUs and 256 GB of CXL memory, XSBench ran at 4.57x over a no-tiering baseline against 1.18x for the current method, and Graph500 hit 3.17x against 2.34x. Redis saw no gain, and NAS BT landed slightly behind. Per-folio promotion cost fell from 26.1 to 15.8 microseconds in an overhead test, though that benchmark finished about 5% slower. These are AMD's own numbers, and the slides list no virtualization support for the profiler. The pghot patches are still in development, and EPYC Venice is in production with cloud deployments expected later this year.

title: Sony Patent Describes Bosses That Learn From Your Reaction Times and Retries

The system collects player data and game data from an encounter with an NPC, feeds both into a machine learning model, and uses whatever the model returns to modify that character.

Following on its launch of the Low Profile 3.0 switch design, which has subsequently made appearances in mechanical keyboards from brands like NuPhy and Chilkey, Gateron has officially launched the latest version of its Low Profile 3.0 switches. The Gateron Low Profile Silent 3.0 Black switch is a linear switch designed with noise-sensitive users and professional environments in mind. As is the case with many other silent switch designs, the Black variant uses silicone o-rings on stem components to silence and cushion the bottom- and top-out sounds. Currently, the Gateron LP 3.0 Black switches are available from Gateron directly at $14 for 35 switches or $44 for 110 switches. 

Unlike many other silent switch designs, the Black Low Profile 3.0 switches aren't limited by their o-rings, and they feature the same 1.7 mm actuation distance and 3.4 mm total travel as their non-silent counterparts. The Black switches are the heaviest in Gateron's silent 3.0 switch line-up, coming in at 50 gf (±15 gf). The switches have a full POM stem with a nylon bottom housing and clear PC top housing, and they are factory lubricated for smooth keystrokes. The clear top housing also means that keyboard backlighting should still be visible through the switch.    Read full story

title: AMD Confirms FSR 4 Is Coming to APUs by the End of 2026

title: Microsoft Rebuilds Windows 11 Search, Adds Typed Commands and Inline Copilot
summary:
Microsoft has unveiled a rebuilt Windows 11 Search at its Windows and Surface event, and it can now change system settings straight from the taskbar. Windows chief Pavan Davuluri showed it on stage, and Microsoft says the box will handle thousands of quick actions typed as simple commands. Examples include "switch to dark mode", "turn on Bluetooth", "dim my screen", "mute", and "minimize all my windows". Microsoft says these are only the first batch, and Phone Link actions such as sending a text message from a connected phone are also planned. The more interesting part for enthusiasts is probably under the hood. The new Search is built on WinUI 3, which Microsoft says makes it faster and lighter on system resources, and early testing apparently showed sizable gains in speed and memory use. 

The layout is now a single list of results, replacing the current design with its large preview pane. Search should also cope better with typos and synonyms, and richer file details and web previews are planned for later this year. Copilot is part of it too, of course. Its answers show up inside Search, with a shortcut to open the full app. This follows the July cleanup that removed ads and promotional content from Search and added a setting to hide web and Microsoft Store suggestions. The new version started rolling out to Windows Insiders in the Experimental channel on October 7. Microsoft is targeting this fall for regular Windows 11 PCs, though there's no exact date yet.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Starts at $2,599, Ships October 16
summary:
Microsoft has finally put a price on the Surface Laptop Ultra, and preorders are open as of today. The announcement came at the company's Windows and Surface keynote in San Francisco, with a starting price of $2,599 and shipments set to begin on October 16. Microsoft first showed the laptop at Computex in June without a price or a launch date. The base model gets a 15-inch mini-LED display and the lower of the two NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X configurations, which means an 18-core CPU, a 5,120-core Blackwell GPU, and 24 GB of unified memory. The 20-core version with a 6,144-core GPU starts at $3,699 with 32 GB, and the top model with 128 GB of memory and a 1 TB SSD costs a steep $5,899. The only 2 TB option is a 64 GB model at $4,699. A Surface RTX Spark Dev Box was also announced at a hefty $5,999.

The other reveal is the oversized USB-C port that has had people guessing since June. Microsoft says the Surface Laptop Ultra is the first laptop in the world with a breakaway USB-C port, so a tripped-over cable should pull free without dragging the machine off the desk. The idea is the same as Apple's MagSafe and Microsoft's own Surface Connect, except those are proprietary connectors. This one apparently still works as a regular USB-C port with any USB-C device. As for the price, the $2,599 entry point is a little lower than expected. A TechPowerUp Forums member who spent about a month with a prototype guessed $2,799 for a 24 GB model. That prototype was tested on preview drivers, however, so readers are advised to wait for reviews of retail hardware before preordering.

title: Samsung HBM4E Passes Testing for NVIDIA's "Rubin Ultra" GPU
summary:
Samsung's upcoming HBM4E memory has reportedly passed testing for NVIDIA's next-generation "Rubin Ultra" AI GPU accelerator family. This is great news for the company, as its previous HBM3E didn't meet NVIDIA's requirements, leading NVIDIA to choose Samsung for GDDR7 only, instead of HBM3E. The new HBM generation brings significant advancements, and Samsung is one of the leading manufacturers with designs currently running at 14 Gbps per pin and 2,048 pins per HBM4E stack. Samsung can achieve a maximum bandwidth of 3.6 TB/s, and at 16 Gbps, this maximum memory bandwidth will increase to 4 TB/s for a single HBM4E stack.

With about a dozen memory stacks per AI accelerator or GPU, the total memory bandwidth will be remarkable. The company is currently offering this memory in a 12-layer (or 12-high) configuration with a memory density of 48 GB per stack. However, customer requirements will also include 8-layer 32 GB and 16-layer 64 GB stacks in the future.  Read full story

title: Intel Prepares Core 2000HX Series for Laptops Based on "Raptor Lake Next"
summary:
Intel is reportedly developing laptop chips based on its rumored "Raptor Lake Next" CPU core architecture, which will be branded as the Core 2000HX series. As readers may recall, Intel is already planning "Raptor Lake Next" chips as an update to its Socket LGA-1700 desktop processors. These chips are necessary to provide options for PC buyers who are stuck with the decade-old DDR4 memory standard due to the DDR5 memory pricing crisis, given that the current Core Ultra "Arrow Lake" processors lack DDR4 backward compatibility.

For mobile "Raptor Lake Next" chips, we can expect Intel to bring a core configuration of up to 8 P-Cores and 16 E-Cores, for a total of 24 cores, similar to the regular "Raptor Lake" and "Raptor Lake Refresh" chips. Since "Nova Lake-HX" laptop chips are expected to carry the Core Ultra 4000HX naming scheme, Intel will drop "Ultra" and downgrade the series naming to Core 2000HX to differentiate the new Intel 18A chips from the older Intel 7 "Raptor Lake" dies that will be part of the "Raptor Lake Next" designs. We can expect slight adjustments, as seen with the "Raptor Lake Refresh," that improve D2D latency and include some minor tweaks. Read full story

title: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 Port Tipped for January 2027, Disc Included
summary:
Forza Horizon 6 will apparently reach the PlayStation 5 on January 26, 2027, according to billbil-kun, the generally reliable leaker at Dealabs. That would put the port a little over eight months behind the Xbox Series X|S and PC versions, which launched on May 19, and it would miss the 2026 window that Microsoft and Playground Games have been promising since January. The game is also said to be getting a physical disc release on the same day as the digital version. That is a change from Forza Horizon 5, which arrived on PS5 in April 2025 as a digital-only title. Pricing is reportedly set at €69.99 in Europe and £59.99 in the UK, the same as the Xbox version, and billbil-kun expects the US price to land at $69.99.

An official announcement is expected as early as this week, with pre-orders opening shortly after. Of course, neither Microsoft nor Playground Games has confirmed any of this. In early September, the studio's own blog still said the PS5 version would be out "later this year". The Verge's Tom Warren had been saying otherwise since late August, and he later reported that the port was being pushed to early 2027, apparently to coincide with the game's first expansion. It looks like he had it right. PS5 owners should keep an eye out for the official launch date and pre-order details.

title: SK hynix Reportedly Faces Difficulties in HBM Hybrid Bonding, Trailing Samsung
summary:
According to a process development engineer at SK hynix's future technology research institute, who spoke with Damnang, SK hynix is reportedly facing challenges in developing hybrid bonding technology for its HBM memory. These issues are significant enough that SK hynix has not yet begun production of samples, while Samsung has reportedly already sent out samples of HBM manufactured using hybrid bonding to customers. If true, this represents a major setback for SK hynix, whose HBM has held the top spot in global market share by revenue. This could potentially lead to a loss of market share among customers who require higher capacities, better performance, and more advanced technology from their HBM suppliers.

For those unfamiliar, hybrid bonding creates a permanent bond between two silicon chips using embedded metal bumps that are fused together to form a single chip. Multiple dies or entire silicon wafers can be connected by stacking the back ends of two chips together. This technology eliminates traditional chip bumps and directly bonds copper interconnections between the two chips. Essentially, hybrid bonding can create shorter distances, reducing latency and improving performance, lowering signal distortion, and offering many other benefits. Read full story

title: Samsung Foundry to Manufacture Anthropic AI ASIC on 2 nm Node
summary:
Samsung Foundry may be on the verge of securing a significant deal with AI lab Anthropic to manufacture AI accelerators. According to the latest report, Anthropic is developing its custom AI accelerator on Samsung's SF2 2 nm node, which will initially be produced in a lower volume of around 200,000 chips. The design and implementation of this ASIC are being handled by Broadcom, targeting around 4,000 TOPS of INT8 compute, with a TDP of 1,300 W per chip. This will be supported by either 192 GB of HBM3E or even 288 GB of HBM3E, if the design allows. The current production volume is low, as ASIC projects are typically counted in millions of chips. However, Anthropic is likely evaluating the project's viability, which requires a complete custom infrastructure with networking, rack design, power supply, cooling, and many other factors.

The current Samsung SF2 node is built using Low-NA EUV lithography and is manufactured in South Korea, with a new facility soon to be established in Taylor, Texas. For packaging these chips and integrating them with HBM, Samsung is likely to employ its I-Cube technology, which rivals TSMC's CoWoS and allows for 2.5D packaging. Combined with the 2 nm dies, Samsung can position itself as a serious manufacturing plant for external customers and slightly close the gap with TSMC and its contract manufacturing business. title: Volatiles takes the piece-by-piece map building of boardgames like Betrayal at House on the Hill and slaps a gory survival shooter on top of them
summary:
I do love a boardgame where you reveal the tiles as you play. Sure, I also enjoy turning over all the pieces at the beginning of a game of Settlers of Catan and taking in all the tiles and trying to work out a strategy based on which resources are clustered near which port, but that's not the same as a game like Betrayal at House on the Hill, where you all start together in one single room and unveil the architecture of the house tile by tile as you explore. You have that same strategic eye, looking at the function and threat each room holds, but because the house is still being built, your plan can't become fixed. You have to reassess the layout of the building with each new piece and, of course, when you hit the moment in the game where one player betrays you the real danger arrives, all that planning now has to be twisted to oppose the new threat.
Volatiles is an action game that plays with that same sense of strategy and mystery. It starts with you waking in a strange facility with little sense of what brought you there. The scientists around you say they're helping you, but they're the same people who keep dunking you into a sensory deprivation tank and forcing you to fight the monsters in your mind.
It's just possible they don't have your best interests at heart.

title: "Your body is foreign territory": Small-town mystery puzzler Patience is a Virtue explores power and vulnerability by way of a unique conversation system
summary:
The English language can be a way of communicating, and it can be a way of subjugating. Patience is a Virtue protagonist Louis knows this intimately. In this "cozy-meets-creepy" conversation puzzle game from teaisfortoby!, some interactions require you to answer only using the words spoken by the other party.


The first such chat in the demo is with Louis's boss at the local grocery store. She wants him to lock up early. All Louis has to do is assent. But to assent, he must reassemble her phrasing into a coherent, five-word response, grappling not just with elementary grammar but phantom questions of tone. Being the first of these puzzles, it's an easier one, but the constraint is rather suffocating nonetheless. Louis is chronically ill and neurodivergent, and his difficulty talking back reflects his lack of privilege. These words don't belong to him. They are alien objects he must painstakingly bolt together on demand.

summary:
After my six hours of hands-on time with Phantom Blade 0 in LA, I was sold on the game. The boss design is amazing, the soundtrack is killer, and the beautiful wide linear environments have great metroidvania style side distractions.

title: Arc Raiders Taking Stock Quest Guide
summary:
Arc Raiders occasionally loves to send you to multiple maps for a single quest, and that's the case with Taking Stock. In this lengthy quest, you'll need to visit at least three maps, take some photos, ping some baddies, and more. We're here to help, though. Here's everything you need to do to complete Taking Stock in Arc Raiders.


		
			
				
					
						In This Article					
					
						
							
						
					
				
				
					On Stella Montis, take a photo of the sculpture in the AtriumOn Spaceport, take a photo of a Baron HuskOn Dam Battlegrounds, ping a Bombardier / On Buried City, ping a BastionDeliver 3 Industrial Batteries to the Nomadic Envoys				
			
		
		


Note that you'll need to bring a camera with you for this quest, as you'll be taking multiple photos.



On Stella Montis, take a photo of the sculpture in the Atrium



Your first step is to take a photo of the sculpture in the Atrium on Stella Montis. The Atrium can be easily found on the southeastern side of the map. It serves as a convergence point for various other pathways.



Atrium location



When you arrive, note the giant sculpture in the middle of the Atrium. 



Take a photo of the sculpture.



Take out your camera and snap a picture of it, then exfil when you're ready.



On Spaceport, take a photo of a Baron Husk



Next up, you should head to Spaceport to take a photo of a Baron Husk. These are large, dormant ARC that can be found in multiple spots around the map. Two of the easiest to find are circled below on the southern side of the region.







When you find one, take out your camera and snap a pic.



Take a photo of the Baron Husk.



Afterward, head to an extraction point and get out while you're still breathing.



On Dam Battlegrounds, ping a Bombardier / On Buried City, ping a Bastion



The next step of the quest is easy. Simply head to either Dam Battlegrounds and ping any Bombardier, or head to Buried City and ping any Bastion. You only need to do one or the other, not both.













These ARC can be found in various areas across the maps. Some popular spots are shown above.



Deliver 3 Industrial Batteries to the Nomadic Envoys



Lastly, you just need to find and deliver three Industrial Batteries to the Nomadic Envoys. Industrial Batteries can be found in (shocker) Industrial areas. Simply search every nook and cranny in the spots below on Dam Battlegrounds for an easy way to get your hands on some.



Look for Industrial Batteries in Industrial zones.



When you've found all three Industrial Batteries, head back to Speranza and turn in the quest to knock another one off your list.



With that quest wrapped up, check out our full Arc Raiders mission list to get more assistance with your questing.

title: Ben Affleck Has Some Strong Opinions About Fortnite Skins And How Hard The Game Is For Him
summary:
Have you ever wondered what two-time Oscar-winner Ben Affleck thinks about Fortnite skins, and the game generally? You can now rest easy, as the man himself has weighed in with some strong takes.



Appearing on the New Heights podcast with brothers Jason and Travis Kelce, Affleck said he's a big gamer, and is particularly fond of first-person shooter games, so when he tried Fortnite, he thought he'd hold his own. That wasn't the case, though. He said not only did he get wiped out immediately, but the 12-year-olds he was playing against made fun of him after taking him out. 



Affleck said he got heated and shouted back at the kids: "I don't suck! I'm a grown man!" 




https://twitter.com/yonann/status/2108191229884133646




Affleck also told a brief story about how his son wanted Fortnite skins for Christmas, and he was shocked to learn the specific skins his son wanted cost hundreds of dollars. "They ain't even real? Just to wear in the game? That's bullsh**," Affleck said.



Affleck is a big fan of the competitive shooter Valorant. In the movie Gone Girl, Affleck's character can be seen playing Battlefield 3. 



Affleck is not the only person who has some strong words for the state of Fortnite. Writing for GameSpot, Phil Owen recently talked about why Fortnite sucks this season.

title: Ubisoft Shutting Down Rainbow Six Mobile After Less Than A Year
summary:
Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game soft-launched in 2023, but properly rolled out for everyone back in February 2026. It will shut down on January 16, 2027, so it will have been online for less than a year in its full state for everyone.



"'We are proud of the passion, creativity, and dedication our team has put into the game," Ubisoft said. "One of the greatest parts of this adventure has been getting to experience it alongside you. We've loved seeing the memes, videos, strategies, tournaments, impossible plays, and all the countless moments that happened because you were here."



The developers are going to move on to "other long-term strategic projects," but Ubisoft did not say what these may be. The studio will share more details on the game's final days in the coming weeks. 



"We are truly grateful to everyone who has played our game," the developers said.



Rainbow Six Mobile pitched itself as a mobile version of the extremely popular Rainbow Six Siege, which continues to crush it more than a decade after release. The next Rainbow Six game is Rainbow Six Tactics, and it's coming next year.



It's been a bumpy year for Ubisoft, as the company created a new organizational structure by way of its partnership with Tencent. As part of this, Ubisoft enacted mass layoffs, closed studios, and cancelled games.

title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting A Movie Adaptation At Call Of Duty Film Studio, Transformers Producer On Board
summary:
Movie studio Paramount has announced that it's making a Cyberpunk 2077 movie, becoming just the latest upcoming game adaptation. The studio is also behind the Call of Duty movie that's set for release in 2028.



Deadline reported that Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the super-popular Transformers movie series, is attached to produce. CD Projekt Red is on board as well to produce, which might make fans happy to hear.



CD Projekt Red's Michał Nowakowski praised Paramount, saying the company shares the developer's ambitions.



"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time," he said.



Cyberpunk 2's associate game director, Paweł Sasko, said, "I’m beyond excited chooms."



Cyberpunk 2077 is headed to the big screen.



Not all Hollywood adaptations include their creators, as Larian has no involvement in the Baldur's Gate 3 TV show, while Naughty Dog dropped out of The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO, prompting fears about creative decisions. 



Paramount has been in the news a lot lately following the company's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery and combination of the two companies. Going forward, the parent company will be called Skydance.



Presumably the Call of Duty and Cyberpunk 2077 movies are among those set for release in theaters, following Paramount's commitment to releasing at least 30 movies in theaters each year.



It is very early days for the Cyberpunk 2077 movie, and there is no word yet on who may direct or star in it, nor has Paramount given it a release date. 



The game series, meanwhile, is expanding with a sequel, Cyberpunk 2, which is in development now.



Cyberpunk 2077 had a well-documented disastrous launch in December 2020, but the Polish developer steadily supported, updated, and improved the game over the years. Many are calling it one of the best comeback stories ever for a high-profile game. Things culminated in the Cyberpunk 2077 2.0 release in 2023 and the launch of the stellar Phantom Liberty expansion. The game has sold more than 40 million copies.

title: Arc Raiders Celeste’s Teenage Rebellion Quest Guide
summary:
Arc Raiders' new Frozen Trail update has brought with it a brand-new map to explore, but some of its quests still send you to previous maps to do a bit of busywork. For instance, for Celeste's Teenage Rebellion, you'll need to make your way back to Riven Tides. Here's what you need to know about completing this task for Celeste.

Reach the lookout tower on Mulatierra Hill



The first part of the quest requires you to visit the lookout tower on Mulatierra Hill, which can be found in the center of the map. 



Lookout tower location



The tower is hard to miss. Make your way inside, then take the ladder up to the top.



Transmit the location from the top of the tower



At the top of the tower, transmit your location at the prompt.



Transmit your location here.



Next, we're heading west.



Reach the old Raider Camp near the hotel, overlooking the beach



You'll now need to make your way to a Raider Camp between the beach and the hotel on the western side of the map. Check the map below for the exact location.



Raider Camp location

Search for the radio transmitter at the Raider Camp

title: GTA 6 Merch Revealed, Including T-Shirt With Alligator Wearing Sunglasses And Drinking A Cocktail
summary:
Ahead of GTA 6's release in November, Rockstar Games has announced an official merch collection for the game, and it includes some snazzy stuff like a t-shirt featuring an alligator wearing sunglasses and drinking a cocktail.



The alligator's name is Macca the Gator, and he's the star of a fictional in-universe TV show of the same name. Presumably we will learn more about this at some point, but I am certainly intrigued.



All the GTA 6 merch you can buy right now.

There are also a collection of branded hats in black, pink, and blue, along with a GTA 6-branded Zippo lighter, canvas tote bags, and vinyl stickers, among other offerings.

In addition to this merch, Rockstar partnered with the NBA's Miami Heat for a "Vice City Collection" of gear you can buy right now.



GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game will have a lot of great music in it, as well as podcasts, and famous radio hosts.

title: Forza Horizon 6 For PS5 Delayed To 2027, And First Paid Expansion Releases Alongside It For All Platforms
summary:
Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a new report says the game has in fact been delayed to 2027. This has now been confirmed by Sony: Forza Horizon 6 will now release on January 26, 2027.



Reputable leaker billbil-kun originally said Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 was set for release on January 26, 2027, so that reporting was accurate. There will be a physical disc edition at retail, and the game will also be sold digitally.



Early access will start on January 21, for people who pay more to buy the game's Premium Edition. Developer Panic Button made the PS5 edition; that's the same studio behind the PS5 port of Forza Horizon 5. Playground Games and Turn 10 worked "in close collaboration" with Panic button on the ports.




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKo9Rnh8bkA




Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 will have a 4K 30FPS "Quality" mode and a 60FPS "Performance" mode. The trailer above stems from the Quality mode.



All preorders for Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 include a pre-tuned Ferrari J50 that will show up in your garage after completing the prologue.



The PS5 edition will support cross-play and cross-saves with the Xbox and Steam versions. All of the Forza Horizon 6 user-generated content is available cross-platform, too. 



Additionally, Microsoft announced that the first paid expansion for Forza Horizon 6 will launch on January 21, 2027. It's included with the game's Premium Edition, Premium Upgrade, and Expansions Bundle, or can be purchased separately (pricing was not confirmed). Microsoft did not provide any details on what's in the paid expansion, however. It's the first of two planned paid expansions.



Additionally, a free content update for all players on all platforms is coming to Forza Horizon 6 in 2027 for the launch of the PS5 edition and the expansion. "We will share more details about this closer to release," the studio said.



In September, Microsoft said in a blog post that the PS5 edition of the popular racing game was due for release in 2026, but plans have changed. 



Forza Horizon 6 was released in May this year for Xbox Series X|S and PC. The game, which is set in Japan, scored rave reviews, including an 8/10 from GameSpot, and PlayStation fans have had to wait for their turn to play.



The last game in the series, Forza Horizon 5, was a huge hit on PlayStation 5. In other Forza news, Microsoft recently announced that Forza developers Turn 10 and Playground are merging to become one unified studio to support and grow the brand going forward.

title: Triple-I Initiative October 2026: Everything Announced At The Showcase
summary:
We normally get only one Triple-I Initiative showcase per year, but 2026 is proving to be the exception. The second broadcast of the year from organizers Evil Empire, the Triple-I Initiative was a focused blast of curated trailers and game updates, all rolling out across an almost-hour-long livestream. If you don't have time, fret not, because we've recapped everything below for you to check out. Most of these games also have demos now live on Steam, so if you like what you see, you can get an early taste right now.



Aftergods




https://youtu.be/9tmDraA3FrI




After Ragnarok annihilated most of the deities who safeguarded the land, it's up to the survivors of that cataclysm to form a new pantheon and push back the monsters that have risen up in their absence. The debut trailer for Aftergods featured some godly DNA--it was produced by the team behind the Blood of Zeus and Castlevania animated series--and this top-down survivalite ARPG is coming to PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5.



Waltz and Jam




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-lfSS002Ezo




Korean developer Flyway Games announced hand-drawn action-adventure Waltz and Jam has a release date, and you can get your hands on this cute little afterlife game starting December 3. It'll be launching for PC, Switch 2, and PS5.



Among Us Story: On Guard




https://youtu.be/RzIWYTHHCtI




A new Among Us standalone game in which you have to prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew? Nothing sus about that! Billed as both a narrative and detective game, Among Us Story: On Guard launches on February 17, 2027 for PC, Switch consoles, and mobile.



Astral Ascent




https://youtu.be/dgS44SPIixI




Astral Ascent's next update adds some Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 flavor to the popular roguelite, as well as a ton of new content. The free Expedition 33 For Those Who Come After update is now available on PC and console, adding new summons, bosses, and a huggable Esquie. Wheeeee!



Brotato: Primal Dread




https://youtu.be/2AvmACnnkps




The Primal Dread DLC for Brotato is out on November 2 for PC, adding bigger enemies, new brotatoes, and weaponized panflutes.



Canyons




https://youtu.be/pgq2NDpY_Xk




A new co-op PvE shooter from the creators of Breathedge, Canyons drops you into a brutal, ever-changing world populated with supernatural creatures known as the Awakened. Everything from tombstones to thrones is out to harm you in this strange world, but an itchy trigger finger and Blood Pacts that allow you to wield exotic abilities will help keep you alive long enough to establish a settlement. Canyons is coming to PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S in November 2027.



Chained Together




https://youtu.be/8PvjKlUvouY




Co-op game Chained Together is getting its first new map on November 12. Your climb out of hell is just getting started, and a new gameplay mode will also test teams by seeing just how quickly they can overcome the trials of the damned.



Dandelion Void




https://youtu.be/Psm3fo_ezww




Dandelion Void has a simple premise: The game wants to know if you have what it takes to survive the hostile jungle-choked halls of a derelict spaceship adrift between the stars. You'll need to establish a refuge to keep the horrors at bay, and if that sounds like a grand time, you can try a demo ahead of its Steam Early Access launch next year.



Dave the Diver X Subnautica 2 DLC




https://youtu.be/Rp4KqJEnr_U




After teaming up with Sega's Yakuza series and running into Godzilla, Dave the Diver's next crossover brings the wet world of Subnautica to his shores. Out in early 2027, you can expect the casual single-player adventures of Dave the Diver to be fused with the alien oceans of Subnautica 2--which should make for some interesting sushi dishes.



Drunken Goddess Reflux




https://youtu.be/VrQPbptH3eQ




Summary: From the developers of "Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis" comes their latest title: Drunken Goddess Reflux! Play shot-glass Russian roulette against Femme Soule, a demon who loves you to death--literally! Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon until she spills it all.



Escape The Backrooms




https://youtu.be/csuzytGT-G0




And now for some liminal horror! Escape the Backrooms is getting a new "After Party" update in December, adding new levels to the game. New skins are also coming later this month, and if you haven't tried it yet, Escape the Backrooms is a co-op game that builds on the idea of analog horror. It's available for PC and consoles.



False Echo




https://youtu.be/wIh2OoWjbyU




Like Papers, Please combined with Das Boot, False Echo's blend of submarine warfare and cryptography thrills will be surfacing on PC in Spring 2027. To give you an idea of what the full game will be like, you can try the demo right now.



Gods with Badges




https://youtu.be/MXdR706AKPQ




Fans of turn-based tactics games have been eating well lately, and Gods with Badges from Strange Scaffold (I Am Your Beast, Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator) looks like another delicious entry in that genre. With a focus on narrative sequences and brutal turn-based battles, players will step into the boots of disgraced police officer Harrow McClellan as she seeks to change lives and pursue her own version of justice. Combat requires you to follow the rules, but turning off your body-cam can unlock special dialogue and combat options if you're prepared to deal with the consequences of going dark.



Haunted Paws




https://youtu.be/dCcOI-fwU6w




A spooky co-op game where you get to play as two adorable dogs? Sign us up! Haunted Paws lets you send your puppies on an adventure through a haunted mansion to locate your missing owner, and it's coming to PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and Switch. On PC, you can grab a demo for it on Steam. 



Hela: of Mice & Magic




https://youtu.be/Awbht9ANxE8




Out on December 1, Hela: Of Mice & Magic is a cute adventure game featuring a brave little mouse. Set in a world inspired by Northern Sweden, the game encourages you to be a force for good. A PC demo is out now, and the game launches on December 1 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Switch 2, and Switch. It'll also be a day-one release through Xbox Game Pass.



Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5OpnVoxkmE




The fourth DLC expansion for Risk of Rain 2, Hallowed Concepts adds new regions, enemies, and bosses to fight in the dark, cult-like world of N’Kuhana. It's out now for PC and consoles.



The Escapists 3




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xl_dBtp2PKQ




Team17 revealed a new entry in The Escapists franchise, building on the foundation of previous games to offer more 3D prison hijinks. It's out in 2027.



Machinarium 2




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9GosoACCaBs




Amanita Design has a new Machinarium sequel on the way, almost 20 years after the first game was released. There's no release date yet, but so far it looks like a gorgeous follow-up to the original, with its unique art.



Lazare's Sacrifice




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f2bTtzyxGak




A narrative deckbuilder that has been designed in collaboration with Damien Monnier--the game designer behind the original Gwent and Gwent: The Witcher Card Game--Lazare's Sacrifice is set during the height of the French Revolution, and it tasks you with not losing your head.



The Talos Principle 3




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UB-btaymgEY




The final entry in the series, The Talos Principle 3 is once again being developed by Croteam, and it'll offer plenty of thought-provoking puzzles to solve.



Militsioner




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ft-3PUM23Wo




First revealed in 2020, Militsioner is an immersive talking sim with a unique hook--you're being followed by a Godzilla-sized policeman, who is keeping a giant eye on you in spite of your protestations of innocence. You need to pack your bags and skip town to avoid the extremely long arm of the law, but be careful, because the Giant Policeman is watching your every move.



Pony Island 2




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9QX_lfkK2gM




The next game from Inscryption creator Daniel Mullins, Pony Island 2 is getting a public playtest soon.



Stronghold 4




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jg-WjI1EzBA




The original castle sim franchise is back, and Stronghold 4 has an official release date of December 7. Like the previous games, it's all about honing your siegecraft and protecting your fortress from invading armies.



Windrose: Ashlands Update




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e3K2wjkbfVA




Ahoy, mateys! Windrose's first major expansion, Ashlands, adds a new biome, quests, armor, weapons, challenges, and a menacing boss. It's scheduled to set sail in the winter season.



Vaultbreakers




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDJx0Q8quuE




A top-down extraction RPG, you'll need preparation, knowledge, and skill to clear your path to the Dragonvault in Vaultbreakers. A demo is now available.



Too Deep To Quit




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_HKlaGK23M4




The co-op survival game--that is best described as Indiana Jones with puppets--got a new trailer, and you can also try out a demo for it on PC via Steam.



Volatiles




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gWYRShsmwK8




A top-down action roguelike from indie studio Team Instant Defeat, Volatiles tasks you with strategically fighting alien hordes, unlocking powerful weapons, and turning the arena itself into a weapon--all while sinister forces watch and manipulate your mind.



Revamp




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IDundXh6aa0




Billed as a tower Defensevania from the creators of Moonlighter, ReVamp has an official release date of March 25, 2027 for its PC Steam release.



Jiaohun




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lUNGg3a-y1M




Are you in the mood for a first-person psychological horror game set in a small Chinese town during the 1990s? Then check out Jiaohun when it launches next year on PC and PS5.



Outward 2




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tTsMBNhVyig




Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pQx4TODuB2k




Set beneath a scorching sun, you can explore new Egypt-inspired lands and monuments in this Kingdom Two Crowns expansion.



Living Hell




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rg_ib0KnwPw




A new co-op survival-horror game from the creator of Devour, Living Hell follows players as they capture mutated specimens and turn them into biofuel to help power a train on their journey to escape a doomed planet.



Prison of Husks




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gTOGBRMpEu4




What if soulslikes hit the scene during the early 2000s? Then you'd get a game like Prison of Husks, which mixes the familiar gameplay of that genre with PS2-era graphics. It has parries, pistols, and something else that starts with a P, as you explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts--and challenging bosses, of course.



RockBeasts




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gbhvq6zHLvU




Why is Iggy Pup wearing a shirt in this trailer, and is he a pup rocker? We hope to see answers to all these questions when this rock-and-roll management RPG launches in January 2027.



Prospice: Anomalous Logistics




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2cV7PIg5oTA




Explore an uncharted island with your trusty truck, and try not to get waylaid by the treacherous terrain--that happens to have been warped by the remains of decaying gods--as you plot a route to safety. Or if you're feeling brave, you can leave the safety of your truck and uncover occult artifacts.



Little Prince Tyger




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FbaX6FKvLKQ




A bloody 2D action roguelike, Little Tyger features 1,000+ single-screen levels with physics-simulated environments and enemies. It's like a heavy metal version of Celeste.



Wyldheart




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X88HFhWATps




Wyldheart has a demo out now on Steam, so if you and some friends want to jump into a new action-RPG set in a fantasy land, give this game a whirl. It's from Wayfinder Studios, a small 12-person indie team in Sweden founded by the former creative director of Star Wars Battlefront.



Trainwatch




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vCVkQiRytK4




A psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing, being a gatekeeper has never been more dangerous than in this game--especially when you have to deal with occult forces and unsettling folks.



Isle Goblin




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zXTw84DXWj0




After several years of hard work, Isle Goblin's first open playtest is now live on Steam. As a lowly goblin, it's up to you and your fellow goblinkin to use every tool at your disposal to fight back against invading humans and rebuild what was once yours.



Sulfur




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8DS-ExBDSFQ




The roguelike first-person shooter Sulfur is ready to leave Steam Early Access, as it'll launch in 1.0 on October 28. The game is also coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2.

title: Strange Scaffold Saved This New Tactics Game From Cancellation
summary:
One of the more interesting game reveals from today's Triple-i Initiative showcase was Gods With Badges, a narrative-driven tactics game about a disgraced police officer returning to the line of duty. What makes Gods With Badges even more fascinating is that it was canceled by its original developer and saved by El Paso, Elsewhere developer Strange Scaffold.




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MXdR706AKPQ




The press release announcing Gods With Badges explained that the project began at Artificer, the Devolver Digital-owned studio behind games like Minos, Sumerian Six, and Showgunners. Originally called Hard Justice, the project ultimately didn't pan out and almost never saw the light of day. 



Meanwhile, Strange Scaffold is spearheading an initative called Project Share, which encourages developers to share the original code for their games so other studios can riff on it. This previously helped enable the development of another Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion game and has now saved an Artificer game from cancellation.



The press release explains that Gods with Badges took the work already completed by Artificer and reinterpreted it "through Strange Scaffold's distinctive creative lens." Studio Head Xalavier Nelson Jr. added that he is "deeply grateful to the original developers at Artificer for trusting us with their project, and can't wait for people to see what we've built on this complex, exciting foundation."



Gods With Badges follows a disgraced police officer named Harrow McClellan as she patrols the dystopian city of Scarhelm. Each encounter starts with choice-driven conversations but can devolve into isometric, turn-based combat. Players can even turn off their bodycam to gain access to more combat abilities, though this will obviously affect how the narrative plays out. 



I expect this game to tackle subjects like police brutality and the role of law enforcement in an increasingly dystopian world. Gods With Badges will be released on PC sometime in 2027.

title: Arc Raiders Tracks Of The Beast Quest Guide
summary:
You've probably already spent some time running around in the snow on Arc Raiders' new Pendola Pass map, but it's time to head back there once again for the Tracks of the Beast quest. This time, you need to visit a few locations and ping a few baddies, and we're here to fill you in on how to make it all happen.


		
			
				
					
						In This Article					
					
						
							
						
					
				
				
					On Pendola Pass, head to the Northern TracksFind the destroyed station at the end of the tracksPing a Bully / Ping a Skulker				
			
		
		


On Pendola Pass, head to the Northern Tracks



The first step of the quest requires you to head to the Northern Tracks POI, which is located (you guessed it) on the northern tip of the map. 



Northern Tracks



Make your way all the way up to this POI to receive a follow-up objective.



Find the destroyed station at the end of the tracks



Next, you'll need to find a destroyed station. From the Northern Tracks, head southwest to find Almatera Station.



Almatera Station



Arriving at this location will complete this portion of your quest. 



Ping a Bully / Ping a Skulker



The final part of this quest requires you to ping a Bully and a Skulker. These are two new ARC foes added in the Frozen Trail update. 



You can find Skulkers all over the map. These little terrors look like futuristic remote-controlled cars, and they pack a hell of a punch if they start shooting you. 



Skulker



Ping one, then kill it if you need to, but try to avoid getting overwhelmed with multiple shooting at you at once.



You'll find a Bully or three around the map near POIs, too. We found one near Almatera Station, but they're fairly plentiful in general, so you're bound to come across one with a bit of exploring.



Bully



These are much larger, faster foes that can absolutely demolish you in the blink of an eye if you're caught in the open. Use cover if you're looking to take one down. But for the sake of this quest, feel free to just ping one and move on.



Once you've pinged these ARC, you can extract and head back to Speranza at your leisure. Of course, you can also kill three Skulkers and return a Skulker Targeter to Shani to complete the optional part of the quest if you so choose.



Either way, with that quest wrapped up, check out our full Arc Raiders mission list for more tips on how to complete additional quests in this popular extraction shooter.

title: Arc Raiders’ Big Update Has It Surging To Numbers It Hasn’t Seen In Months
summary:
When Embark said it would take several months to deliver the major Arc Raiders update it envisioned, days like today were probably the goal. The extraction shooter is once again high up in Steam's charts for both best-selling and most-played games. 



Among best sellers, Arc Raiders currently ranks fifth, behind this week's other big releases, Star Wars: Galactic Racer and Gears of War: E-Day, but those came out earlier this week, and it's still early, so we may see it leap over those before the week is through. Its new cosmetic DLC, the Frozen Trail Collector's Set, is also selling very well. It currently sits at #8 on the best-sellers list.



As for concurrent players, Arc Raiders has eclipsed triple digits on Steam, something it hasn't done since May. It's sitting at 106,000--that's good for 12th on the list--and has actually gained 5,000 more players since I started writing this. Like its sales surge, it seems likely that it'll keep climbing throughout the day. 



Not coincidentally, May was when Embark announced it would be moving to a semi-annual cadence for major updates, with today's Frozen Trail being the first such update since that change. Embark felt it needed more time to deliver bigger updates for players while giving developers breathing room for a healthier work environment. 



I've been fascinated by that bold move because it's rarely seen in the world of extremely popular live-service games. Arc Raiders never really dropped off completely; it still averaged 40,000 concurrent Steam players in September, but it was close to averaging half a million last holiday season, so the fall was precipitous, even if those numbers were likely never to be sustained. 



The first day post-update can't tell the whole story on whether this revised roadmap pays off for Embark, but it's clearly off to a strong start.



Arc Raiders will be free-to-play this weekend on all of its available platforms.
